items.text: David Montgomery (groin) off injury report after full practices, cleared and expected to play Thursday vs Colts; Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out.
items.why: Full participant all week, no designation; Marks out opens three-down role.
items.implication: Montgomery RB2/flex with heavy volume vs weak Colts run D; reverse prior handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries/red-zone with Marks sidelined.

items.text: Andy Reid said Kenneth Walker (groin) is getting better but they don't want to do something stupid; Levitan fully agrees, especially with huge Week 12 at BUF, so expect another sit despite Chiefs big home favorites.
items.why: Reid quote on not rushing; Levitan notes Emmett Johnson just crushed and schedule context.
items.implication: Sit Walker; Emmett Johnson smash start again as lead back.
items.opportunity: Full backfield to handcuff/backup if Walker out.

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to foot injury; trending toward possible sit vs Lions with Jalon Daniels taking first-team reps.
items.why: DNP coming off bye after foot/ankle strain from Week 9; Bowles says progress but decision Friday.
items.implication: Bucs pass game downgrade if out; Daniels superflex streamer, Bucky Irving etc elevated in run-heavy script.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and skill players usage shift.

items.text: Colts ruled out multiple for TNF vs Texans: CB Charvarius Ward (knee), OT Bernhard Raimann (concussion), others; Sauce Gardner questionable.
items.why: Walk-through report; multiple DNPs leading to outs.
items.implication: Texans offense (Montgomery, Nico) boosted vs depleted Colts D/OL.

items.text: Vikings set season-high Pass Rate Over Expectation in first game with Kirk Cousins; O'Connell wants to throw a lot, boosting Justin Jefferson routes/targets.
items.why: Data confirms pass-heavy script with Cousins; prior positive PROE even with bad QB play.
items.implication: Jefferson WR1 lock with elevated volume; Vikings QB-friendly playoff DvP too.

items.text: Brock Bowers (ankle) DNP Wednesday, day-to-day per coach; significant but not as bad as feared, could play without practice vs DEN.
items.why: Left Week 10 early after multiple attempts to return; Kubiak day-to-day, progressing.
items.implication: Monitor practice Thu/Fri; if out Michael Mayer elevated targets.
items.opportunity: TE1 if active; Mayer/WR volume if OUT.

items.text: Drake Maye ankle injury potentially season-ending (possible fracture); Patriots move forward without him, hard negatives for NE offense post-Maye.
items.why: Limped off, eval ongoing, Vrabel not ready post-bye; movement-dependent QB.
items.implication: NE offense crater; stream backups or avoid skill players.
items.opportunity: None positive for NE; handcuffs elsewhere.

items.text: Week 11 snaps & pace: TEN @ DAL up in pace (both fast lately, high plays/points); MIA @ BUF slow-paced slog.
items.why: Titans hurry-up under Daboll/Ward; Cowboys high volume; Dolphins/Bills slow.
items.implication: Stack TEN/DAL skill for volume; fade MIA/BUF pace-dependent plays.
items.opportunity: Higher play volume for CeeDee, Titans WRs/RBs.

items.text: Levitan dunks hard on Jonathan Brooks hype: 'The Jonathan Brooks slappies have a mental illness, it's legit scary.'
items.why: Overhyped for role/opportunity in CAR; prefers realism on usage.
items.implication: Avoid or fade Brooks; stick with Hubbard.

items.text: Berry closing it out on Jaylen Waddle: target share nice but fantasy production is not; HATE for rest of season.
items.why: Production lagging despite targets; close-out sell.
items.implication: Sell low or bench; prefer other WRs.
items.conflict: Target share positive but efficiency poor.

items.text: Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on IR; activated S Kerby Joseph from PUP.
items.why: Season-ending injury confirmed via IR placement.
items.implication: Lions pass rush weaker ROS; opponents OL/QB slightly upgraded matchups.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is Berry's RB6 in rest-of-season rankings; FULL CHUB(A) LOVE for production and role.
items.why: Strong recent production and secure lead role in CAR backfield.

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison per coach Kevin O’Connell after thumb surgery; will not go on IR.
items.why: Surgery but coach confirms no IR designation.
items.implication: Shorter absence possible; monitor return timeline vs Jefferson volume.
items.opportunity: Temporary boost to other MIN WRs if extended.

items.text: Geno Smith (ankle/head) limited in practice; coach Aaron Glenn said he will start if healthy vs Chargers; tests showed nothing major.
items.why: Ankle main concern but tests clean; limited but progressive.
items.implication: Likely active; Jets offense more stable if he goes.
items.opportunity: Full snaps if cleared; else Pickett.
